_about: The AI's skill numbers (sim/director/ai.gd, DirAI). Under ADR 0008 the AI plays by the player's rules: it gets an outcome only by an input, and these numbers say how often it makes that input. One difficulty for now (medium); step 4's AI profile adds easy and hard.

pressReact._note: Press (stance-matrix.md section 7.2): a trade or a counter needs the defender's own attack request. Attacked in this stance, the AI has a request in with this chance (one draw; the request goes through its queue). AGGRESSIVE: it trades instead of taking a clean hit. EVASIVE: it counters after a dodge instead of dodging clean. A guard never counters by itself.

_beamAnswer: control-rules.md section 10: the chance the AI answers a beam when it can: with its own signature (45 ki, off cooldown), or else with a heavy blast (40 ki). Easy 0.15, medium 0.35, hard 0.60
_sigPick: the chance an AI attack is the signature, with 50 ki and the cooldown over: about 3 signatures a match (band 2 to 4)
